measurement_status: completed; interpretation is provided separately in this publication

frozen_protocol.scope: 既知混合による時間観測研究。音質、実音声、再合成、F0編集を評価しない。

signal.harmonic_waveform: fixed_gain*sum(sin(2*pi*k*100*(n-offset)/fs)/k); zero phases at translated time origin
signal.harmonic_gain: calculate once from offset=0 whole-record RMS=0.02; reuse exactly for all offsets without renormalization
signal.gate: half-sample centered raised-cosine: sin(pi*(j+0.5)/(2*24))**2; reverse for falling ramp
signal.color_filter: causal lfilter([1-a],[1,-a]), a=exp(-2*pi*3000/48000), zero initial state
signal.offset_handling: translate h, b and p together relative to the fixed frame grid; h is evaluated analytically at (n-offset)/fs; event-relative harmonic phases stay fixed
signal.level_handling: normalize components once; never normalize mixtures or clip

analysis.eligible: finite nonnegative coefficient energy strictly greater than threshold
analysis.low_energy_policy: common A/B undefined ledger; supplementary A_all uses every finite-energy coefficient
analysis.roi_interval: left closed, right open; identical frame indices for every signal/method
analysis.histogram_rule: floor(t*fs/12); left closed, right open; t=0.3 is outside
analysis.timing_metrics_use: all finite defined times, including outside display interval; no clipping
analysis.quantile_rule: inverse weighted empirical CDF: smallest time with cumulative energy >= q*defined_energy
analysis.ground_truth: sample time n/fs weighted by component amplitude squared/fs; same quantiles
analysis.support_regions: half-open sample support intervals, computed on exact assigned times before histogramming
analysis.unknown_energy_policy: retain raw anomaly counts and explicitly named finite subtotals; unknown total makes official region energies and percentages null; incomplete baseline/present makes paired deltas null and their diagnostic finite-subtotal difference is excluded from formal summaries
analysis.confidence_intervals: none; four independent seeds, eight dependent placements per seed

storage.save_inputs: eight h offset records shared across seeds; each b/p shifted component and each mixture as float64 .npy
storage.retained_observations: six 1200-bin energy arrays per record, all 121 frame ledgers per method, ROI/full summaries
storage.reconstruction: input samples + pinned source + manifest + dependency versions reconstruct complex coefficients
storage.expected_total_output: approximately 50–100 MB, depending on CSV/JSON formatting and PNG sizes

decision.primary: continuous metrics and paired differences; no tuned detection threshold or automatic pass/fail
decision.interpretation: burst smearing reduction alone is insufficient; inspect precursor contrast, baseline false energy, undefined/outside energy and placement reversals
decision.posthoc_changes: retain original run; record old/new values, reason, seen results and affected scope; use new source lock and output directory

archived_protocol_status_note_ja: frozen_protocol内のimplementation_only_not_measuredは測定前に固定した履歴の状態。今回の実行完了状態とは別。

measurement_stderr.summary_ja: Matplotlib/Fontconfigの書込み可能キャッシュに関する警告。元stderrは保存。測定プロセスの終了コードは0。原記録の非公開環境パスを含むため本公開物には複製しない。

publication_scope_ja: 数値結果と表示成果物のみ。実装、入力波形、保存分布配列、原ログは配布しない。この公開物だけで元の測定を再実行できるとは主張しない。
